name: covenant
description: Task-scoped, self-expiring, provable capabilities for MCP tool access
long_description: Covenant sits between an AI agent client and an MCP tool server. Every tools/call is checked against a signed, human-approved capability -- task-scoped, TTL-bound, quota-limited -- before it reaches the real tool. This extension wraps the demo synthetic mail server (read_thread, draft_reply, send_reply) so its enforcement, consent, and audit/Merkle logging can be exercised end to end from Claude Desktop.
